biomarker_name.evidence_quote: α-amylase proteins AMY2A and AMY2B, carboxypeptidase CPA1 and the less characterized CUZD1, to be less abundant
biomarker_name.section: Results — Human protein excretion in T1DM and microbial functions
biomarker_name.notes: LTF and ITLN1 were reported as having higher abundance in individuals with T1DM (same section); AMY2A/AMY2B/CPA1/CUZD1 were reported as lower in T1DM. These are exocrine pancreatic and immune-related human faecal proteins identified as differentially abundant, not classical clinical biomarkers with reported numeric values in main text.

biomarker_unit.notes: Units shown as relative abundance (%) on y-axes of Figure 5a,b for AMY2A and AMY2B; no unit specified in text for CPA1, CUZD1, LTF, ITLN1.

biomarker_value.notes: Exact numeric abundance values for these proteins are only shown graphically in Fig. 5a,b (box plots) and Supplementary Table 5, not reported as discrete numbers in the main text.

ecog_performance_status.notes: Not an oncology study; ECOG performance status not applicable/reported.
